fullTextEN: My dad is looking at me.
You don't need to say thank you.

fullTextZH: 她说你不要再说对不起了
fullTextEN: She said you don't need to say sorry again.

fullTextZH: 但是我很喜欢说谢谢和对不起
fullTextEN: But I really like to say thank you and sorry.
For example, in the United States
You say thank you every day.
I also often say thank you.

fullTextZH: 因为韩国人很喜欢说谢谢
fullTextEN: Because Koreans really like to say thank you.

fullTextZH: 在中国说谢谢是一种礼貌
fullTextEN: In China, saying thank you is a form of politeness.
But I say it too much.

fullTextZH: 这个让我的家人和朋友不舒服
fullTextEN: This makes my family and friends uncomfortable.

fullTextZH: 去年我过生日的时候是冬天
fullTextEN: Last year, when I celebrated my birthday, it was winter.

fullTextZH: 我的爸爸妈妈和老公一起吃饭
fullTextEN: My parents and husband had a meal together.

fullTextZH: 我的朋友给我买了一个生日蛋糕
fullTextEN: My friend bought me a birthday cake.
I love eating cake the most.

fullTextZH: 我的老公送了我一件衣服
fullTextEN: My husband gave me a piece of clothing.

fullTextZH: 我的爸爸妈妈给了我一个大红包
fullTextEN: My parents gave me a big red envelope.
I said thank you to my parents.

fullTextZH: 我的老公和爸爸妈妈他们会给我夹菜
fullTextEN: My husband and parents would serve me food.
Every time I said thank you.
You don't need to thank me
You have already said thank you 20 times
Too tired, don't say it again
After eating, I will go pay
We spent 285 yuan on the meal
So he gave me back 15 yuan
He said your dad is right
You really like to say thank you
This is your money, no need to thank
I also really like to say sorry

fullTextZH: 有一次我和我的朋友一起出去玩儿
fullTextEN: Once, I went out to play with my friends
We want to meet at 3 o'clock.
She said today is my birthday.
I'll go buy you a gift.

fullTextZH: 圆圆上个月借了我100块钱
fullTextEN: Yuan Yuan borrowed 100 yuan from me last month.
Hasn't returned it to me yet.
So I said sorry to Yuanyuan.

fullTextZH: 上个月的100块钱你还没有给我
fullTextEN: You still haven't given me the 100 yuan from last month.
You don't need to say sorry.
It's me who should say sorry.
You like to say sorry too much.

fullTextZH: 晚上我们一起坐公交车回家
fullTextEN: In the evening, we take the bus home together.
There are many people on the bus.
There is a man next to me.
Suddenly he stepped on my foot.
His foot was on my foot.

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得我的脚在这里
fullTextEN: Because I feel my foot is here.
So he has no place to stand.

fullTextZH: 英子看着我说你又说对不起
fullTextEN: Yingzi looked at me and said you said sorry again.
But I said thank you again.
Because he moved his foot away.

fullTextZH: 她说你不要再说对不起了
fullTextEN: She said you don't say sorry again.
I will never say sorry again.

fullTextZH: 现在我还是很喜欢说谢谢和对不起
fullTextEN: I still really like to say thank you and sorry now.

fullTextZH: 你们觉得我说的太多了吗
fullTextEN: Do you think I say it too much?
What about you, what do you like to say?
